title: DXF Floor Plan Processing Web Application
summary: A FastAPI/React web application for uploading, processing, and viewing DXF files to extract and filter floor plan images. The apparent SDV match is only the substring "sdv" inside an unrelated conda cache file path in a dependency lock line, with no connection to the Synthetic Data Vault library.
needs: The 'sdv' substring is part of a random build hash in a pip cache path, unrelated to Synthetic Data Vault.
